definitions.ask: Should `,` in an open Parent Task picker accept the highlighted task and start the next target?
definitions.why: `@foo+` opens the picker at once, so `@foo+f,` otherwise needs an extra Return

choices.label: `,` (non-empty filter) or Shift-Return inserts the row plus ` +` and opens the next picker
`,` keeps typing into the filter; the alias waits until the draft ends in `@foo+fix`
